hero.eyebrow: Your European partner for used trucks
hero.headline: Buying or selling a used truck has never been this simple and reliable.
hero.subtitle: Wilmet Trucks makes it simple to buy and sell used trucks, tractors, rigids, semi-trailers and utility vehicles for professionals — all across Europe — with qualified, reliable opportunities ready to hit the road.

propose.title: Got a truck to sell? Wilmet can buy it quickly.
propose.text: Offer your used truck, van, tractor unit, rigid, semi-trailer or professional vehicle. Our team reviews your opportunity, checks the key information and gets back to you quickly with a simple, serious and professional approach.

search.title: Looking for a reliable truck? Wilmet finds the right opportunity.
search.text: Describe the vehicle you're looking for: truck, van, tractor unit, rigid, semi-trailer or specialised vehicle. If a matching opportunity is available, we'll offer it to you. Otherwise, we activate our network to find a vehicle suited to your needs, budget and market.

sellers.title: Selling a vehicle
sellers.s1d: Send the details and photos in just a few minutes.
sellers.s2d: Our experts qualify the vehicle, documents and conditions.
sellers.s3: We get back to you quickly
sellers.s3d: A clear answer, without unnecessary delay.
sellers.s4d: If the opportunity is validated, we complete the transaction.

buyers.title: Looking for a vehicle
buyers.s2d: Across its stock and European network.
buyers.s4d: We follow the transaction until delivery.

why.title: Why Wilmet?
why.1d: A fast reply on opportunities offered or requested.
why.2d: Serious qualification of vehicles, documents and conditions.
why.3d: The ability to buy and resell across multiple markets.
why.intro: With Wilmet Trucks, professionals can sell their vehicles quickly or access qualified, hand-picked used trucks and utilities ready to drive, across Europe.

contact.title: Contact & location
contact.text: Wilmet Trucks — commercial vehicle trading. Contact us for any specific request.
